footer.note: An explainable recommender for domestic travel in Bangladesh.
how.title: Tell Triply your situation
how.lead: No endless browsing. You describe the trip once — Triply filters hard limits, ranks soft fit, then shows the why behind every suggestion.
how.note: Costs and travel times are labelled as estimates so you can plan with honest ranges, not fake precision.
how.step1.title: Describe the trip
how.step1.body: Capture mood, budget per person, trip length, starting city, travel month, and interests in one situation panel — the inputs the ranking engine actually uses.
how.step2.title: See what fits
how.step2.body: Hard constraints remove impossible trips first. Soft signals then rank the rest into a Fit Score — so “good” means matchable, not mysterious.
how.step3.title: Read the why
how.step3.body: Open any result to see matched tags, estimate ranges, season notes, and the factors that lifted or lowered the score — explainable enough for a report, clear enough for a trip.
about.title: Built for Bangladesh, built to explain
about.lead: Triply is an academic, situation-first recommender for domestic tourism — method, transparency, and evaluation matter as much as the interface.
about.stat1.label: Curated destinations
about.stat2.label: Explainable ranking
about.stat3.label: Bilingual UI
about.pillar1.title: Domestic only
about.pillar1.body: A focused set of Bangladesh places — each record keeps source and last-verified fields so facts stay accountable.
about.pillar2.title: Open rankings
about.pillar2.body: Weights, constraints, warnings, and estimate labels stay visible. Nothing is sold as exact when it is an estimate.
about.pillar3.title: Honest media pipeline
about.pillar3.body: Local photos are seeded into MongoDB GridFS and loaded via /api/media — the app does not invent remote image downloads.
about.footnote: Built as coursework: pure recommendation logic in frontend/js/engine, UI in frontend/js/ui, and a small Express API for auth and media.
